What Will You Learn?

Join one of the best Brazilian jiu-jitsu black belts in history as 5-time world champion as Bernardo Faria shows you how older students can unlock better success by taking advantage of these tricky, grindy hacks to your control that can set up stronger finishing submissions. With lessons on how to optimize your approach to mount, back, side control, knee on belly, and more, you’ll be able to reform your game around these unforgiving adjustments.

Bernardo Faria was always unique as a black belt for having tons of success against the best in the world by using the half guard and relying on techniques that were usually for older guys in the room. Still, he was able to work these positions and study them until he could attack all the time with them - and he turned these moves into systems that helped him win 5 world championships at black belt, including an absolute championship in 2015.

Go position to position, seeing what is important for conceptual understanding before Bernardo shows you how to take things to a next level of control with some mean, grinding offense that helps you drive the fight towards some of his favorite submission finishes. Learn how to get more taps from your training partners and opponents with lessons on kimuras, armbars, scarf chokes, ezekiel chokes, and much more.

This 5-part series is packed with techniques and moves for older guys to win without ever needing to scramble, speed up, and use explosiveness. You can learn all these skills - with drills included for rapid development - from one of the best to ever do it, who is now one of BJJ’s most beloved and recognizable instructors.

products.title: Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys: Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Heavy top control is the safest way for an older grappler to win rolls without scrambling, and few people have turned it into submissions better than Bernardo Faria.

  • Bernardo Faria is an IBJJF World Champion at black belt, the 2015 absolute world champion and the co-founder of BJJ Fanatics.
  • In Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys: Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions, Faria breaks down shoulder pressure and tight pins from side control, knee on belly, mount, the back and top half guard, and the chokes and armlocks that come from each one.
  • This isn't just a pinning course, it's a short, complete top game built for grapplers who would rather grind than scramble.


What Will You Learn?

Heavy top control is the safest way for an older grappler to win rolls without scrambling, and few people have turned it into submissions better than Bernardo Faria.

Faria won IBJJF World titles at black belt, including the absolute division in 2015, by relying on pressure and patience instead of speed. He competed for Alliance and co-founded BJJ Fanatics. Now he's sharing a streamlined version of his Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys control system, cut down to under an hour so you can study it quickly and take it straight to the mats.

In Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys: Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions, Faria starts in side control with shoulder pressure, the move to high mount and mount, and what he calls the worst position in jiu-jitsu, then finishes with scarf chokes, the Marcelo-style armbar, the kimura, armbar and choke from north-south. This isn't just a pinning course, it's a short, complete top game built for grapplers who would rather grind than scramble.

Whether you land in knee on belly, mount, the back or top half guard, pressure serves as the thread that ties every position together. You'll learn painful knee-on-belly pressure with the far-side armbar and baseball bat choke, how to open the mount with your hips for the high mount armbar, monoplata, arm triangle, superman attack and Ezekiel, and the collar choke, spread chicken, bow and arrow and Ezekiel from the back.

The system works because it never asks you to be faster or more explosive than your partner. Each lesson builds on control you already have, so you spend less energy holding the position and more of the round attacking. Even from top half guard, shoulder pressure, the forehead against the knee shield and the dog bar keep your partner carrying your weight.

If you've ever wondered how some older grapplers stay on top and keep tapping younger, more athletic partners, the answer is usually in how they use pressure.

Learn how to pin heavier, tire your partners out and finish from the top with Bernardo Faria.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1: Side Control

  • Understanding Side Control
  • How to Apply Shoulder Pressure from Side Control
  • How to Open Up the Side Control to High Mount
  • Side Control to Mount
  • The Worst Position in Jiu-Jitsu
  • Scarf Choke
  • Scarf Choke with Both Hands
  • Inverted Scarf Choke
  • Highlight Reel Submission
  • Marcelo-Style Armbar from Side Control
  • Kimura from North-South
  • Armbar from North-South
  • North-South Choke

Part 2: Knee on Belly

  • Painful Knee-on-Belly Pressure
  • Knee on Belly to Far-Side Armbar
  • Baseball Bat Choke

Part 3: Mount

  • Understanding the Mount
  • Opening the Mount Using Your Hips
  • Armbar from High Mount
  • Monoplata When They Hug You
  • Arm Triangle from Mount Opening Mount with One Underhook
  • Superman Attack from Mount
  • Nasty Ezekiel Choke When They Keep Their Elbows Tight

Part 4: Back

  • Nasty Collar Choke from the Back
  • The Nasty Spread Chicken
  • Bow and Arrow Choke
  • Arm Triangle When They Escape to the Other Side
  • Ezekiel from the Back

Part 5: Half Guard

  • Nasty Shoulder Pressure from Half Guard
  • Forehead vs. Diaphragm Against the Knee Shield
  • Dog Bar
  • Shoulder Pressure from Everywhere

products.title: Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle by Bernardo Faria
products.body:
Six complete Fast Track BJJ courses from Bernardo Faria, built for the grappler who wants to roll smart, stay safe and keep beating younger, stronger training partners.

  • All 6 Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys courses from the Fast Track BJJ series in one bundle
  • A complete game: pressure passing, half guard, escapes from every bad position and high-percentage control and submissions
  • Low-risk, energy-saving techniques that work when you are not the most athletic person on the mat


What Will You Learn?

Bernardo Faria is a five-time IBJJF black belt World Champion, and his game was never built on speed or flexibility. It was built on pressure, timing and a small set of moves done extremely well. That is exactly what the Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys series teaches.

This bundle brings all six courses of the series together. Each one covers a different part of the game, and together they give you a full, connected system you can use from the first grip to the finish.

You start on top with the Pressure Passing System, where Bernardo shows how to pass the guard with weight and position instead of explosiveness. When you end up on the bottom, the Half Guard System gives you a safe, reliable guard to sweep and come back on top.

When things go wrong, Positional Escapes From Everywhere and Submission Escapes cover the defense: how to get out of bad positions and how to escape the most common submissions without wasting energy or risking injury.

Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions shows you how to pin your partner down and finish with simple, high-percentage attacks that do not depend on athleticism.

Omoplata From Everywhere adds one more attack to the system: the omoplata from closed guard, butterfly, half guard, side control, mount and against the turtle, with the finishes for every way your partner tries to roll out of it.

Every technique is chosen with the older or less athletic grappler in mind: low risk, efficient and easy to remember. If you want to keep improving and keep enjoying jiu-jitsu for many years, this is the bundle for you.

Courses Included In This Bundle

  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Pressure Passing System by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Half Guard System by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Positional Escapes From Everywhere by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Submission Escapes by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys Nasty Control & Sneaky Submissions by Bernardo Faria
  • Fast Track BJJ: Jiu-Jitsu For Old Guys: Omoplata From Everywhere by Bernardo Faria

Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

For the first time ever, Bernardo Faria, 5x World Champion and Co-Founder of BJJFanatics, has created an instructional video that showcases his entire game plan. Bernardo's game is renowned as the best for older grapplers because it is simple, easy to understand, and doesn't rely on athleticism.

Why This Game Plan is Perfect for You:

  • Pressure Passing: When on top, Bernardo uses pressure passing, primarily from the knees, which is perfect for older grapplers. This method focuses on control and leverage rather than speed and strength.

  • Half Guard Mastery: From the bottom, Bernardo plays half guard, an effective game to slow down younger and more athletic opponents. This technique allows you to dictate the pace and maintain control.

  • Submissions: Bernardo's submissions are easy to learn and conservative, meaning most of his submissions are not risky and they connect very well with his pressure passing game. This makes them an excellent match for older grapplers.

Comprehensive Instruction:

In this instructional video, Bernardo takes you step-by-step through building his game plan and connecting each move. Developing a solid game plan that works against any opponent is one of the hardest things in Jiu-Jitsu, and that's exactly what Bernardo has perfected over his two-plus decades of experience.

What You'll Learn:

  • Bottom Game: How Bernardo developed his half guard to control and neutralize opponents.
  • Top Game: Techniques for effective pressure passing from the knees.
  • Submission Game: Strategies for connecting submissions to your overall game plan.
  • Back Attacks, Side Control, and Mount Attacks: How Bernardo developed a simple game to attack from these optimal positions in Jiu-Jitsu.
  • Integrated System: How to connect everything into a cohesive, easy-to-learn system.

Benefits:

  • Faster Improvement: The fastest way to get better in Jiu-Jitsu is by developing a game plan with moves that connect seamlessly. Most of the best Jiu-Jitsu athletes in the world have one thing in common: a solid game plan they can rely on against any opponent.
